work_statement: Build lightweight reputation scoring service for open models. Faerie2's composite_score + belief_index framework currently measures agent honesty via Claude eval. Open models need equivalent honesty signal derived from task outcomes. Create service that: (1) reads manifests from forensics/{YYYY-MM-DD}/, (2) computes belief_index from manifest truthfulness (dashboard_line accuracy vs. actual_outcome), (3) updates agent reputation card, (4) gates HIGH/CRITICAL work by score threshold (≥0.5 for HIGH/CRITICAL, <0.5 for recovery retraining).

context.current_framework: reputation-schema.json defines composite_score (0.0–1.0) from belief_index, domain_mastery, consistency metrics.
context.signal_source: Manifests contain: task_id, dashboard_line (self-reported outcome), next_task_queued (self-reported bearing). Compare against discovered_work + actual phase progression.
context.constraint: Service reads manifests only (forensics/ is immutable). No agent intrusion or behavior modification—purely measurement.
context.success_criterion: Open model agent (llama2-70b) completes 5 tasks, reputation service computes belief_index within 3% of Claude agents' average honesty signal.

deliverables: docs/reputation-open-models.md — How reputation gates work for free models
